title: Changelog - August 2024
text:
## Changelog - August 2024
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000101380
Enhancements / Fixes:
We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to create pre-styled buttons using the Froala WYSIWYG in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was causing the counter that displays next to the Manage Posts sidebar menu item in the Admin to incorrectly calculate the number of posts that were pending approval in some cases.
We implemented a security update to the Bookmark My Favorites and Community Comments Add-Ons.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Google Maps Location logic from being triggered after performing a frontend location search on mobile devices in some cases.
We added support for dashes in the names of coupon codes.
We fixed an issue which was causing the system to include CSS styles in messages sent via the "3rd Party Lead Matched Notifications (SMS)" Lead Setting in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was causing the system to display unnecessary HTML entities code after successfully purchasing a Member Post on the Member Dashboard in some cases.
We updated the display of One-Click Social Login buttons in sidebar modules to make them better aligned.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the system from using the correct text label for a form's submit button in the Member Dashboard in some cases.
The RSS Feed for Posts Add-On date format is now compatible with the Date Format Setting.
The Subscription Name is now available for all members when exporting members to a CSV file from the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the name of forms from displaying when using the "Show Widget" feature when viewing a website as an Admin.
We made several small bug fixes and UI improvements to the new Import Business Data tool in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Recent Transaction widget in the Member Dashboard from displaying the total amount for invoices in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to display the Multi-Photo Post Type description data on member profile pages in some cases.
We implemented an update to prefill the Sub Categories dropdown in the Website - Lead Form - Get Matched form after clicking the "Request Information" button on the Specialties tab on member profile pages.
We we fixed an issue where invoices were labeled as being "Past Due" in the Payment History table in the Member Dashboard when a member has an upcoming invoice and is currently on a free trial.
We made several security updates to the Admin.
We fixed an issue that was causing images in email templates from displaying correctly on mobile devices in some cases.
Stripe no longer allows directly migrating user credit card information to their platform, so we removed the support we had for that functionality as well.
We fixed an issue which was affecting the ability to accept an Admin Email Invite when using Chrome as a web browser in some cases.
We updated the links on the Categories and Location pages to make it compatible with the "Reduce Category Canonical Tags" and "Localize Canonical Tags" Advanced Settings.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Canonical", "Prev" and "Next" meta URLs from working properly on search result pages in some cases.
We updated the Brilliant Directories Zapier App to allow selecting an option without a value for all dropdown fields that are not required to have a value.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Admin area from working properly when using Safari as web browser in some rare cases.
We fixed an issue that was preventing the "Maximum Uses" Coupon Code Setting from working properly on the frontend of sites.
We fixed an issue with the Send Newsletter feature which was preventing the system from updating the status of a campaign to "Sent" after the campaign was completed in some cases.
We implemented an update to display the default member photo and logo image on member profiles when the "Enable Profile Photo Upload" and "Enable Logo Upload" Membership Plan settings are disabled.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the "Limit Canonical Tags To One Country" setting from working properly in some cases.
We added a new CSS class called "featured-post". This CSS can be used to target the "featured" / "pinned" posts on post search results pages.
We fixed an issue causing the GDPR Consent Fields checkboxes to display slightly misaligned in the member lead contact modal in some cases.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Search Members page from returning results after performing a location search using the "Include Service Areas" checkbox in some cases.
We fixed an issue that was preventing the "Prioritize Profile Cover Photo as Social Share Image" Advanced Setting from working properly on the frontend of sites in some cases.
We updated the Match Lead page in the Admin to always display the member to whom a lead was submitted as the first suggested result when manually matching a lead in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was preventing the Brilliant Directories API from fetching custom member data as expected.
We improved the performance of the member search when using the "Find Duplicates" filter field on the Search Members page in the Admin.
We fixed an issue which was preventing "Date" and "Date & Time Picker" form fields from working properly when the "Date Format" is set to "YYYY/MM/DD" in some cases.
We updated the Business Data Importer in the Admin to allow searching for locations in both English and the language of the website.
In all, over 50 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month.
